## Research

::: card-grid
::: tile
### Machine learning for pharmacometrics

Low-dimensional neural ODEs that integrate pharmacokinetic principles, run in Monolix, NONMEM, and nlmixr2, and support automated model development.

[Learn more →](research.qmd#ml){.tile-link .stretched-link}
:::

::: tile
### Dose optimisation

Estimating, rather than simulating, doses that fulfil therapeutic targets with OptiDose, and model-informed dosing for paediatric patients.

[Learn more →](research.qmd#dosing){.tile-link .stretched-link}
:::

::: tile
### Paediatric & clinical pharmacometrics

Pharmacometric analyses for clinical studies in paediatrics and global health, from neonates to adolescents.

[Learn more →](research.qmd#clinical){.tile-link .stretched-link}
:::
:::
